decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to the black-finish range with a dedicated product page and quantified launch, and escalation of commitment makes it unlikely to write off that visible investment.
The shower channel has been given a dedicated page and launch announcement, reflecting clear public commitment and investment that management will likely continue to justify.

Although less publicly announced than A and B, the firm has already invested in the pump-drain concept and placed it on the market, and early disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary adoption factors.
